title: Cannot build Godot with `dev_build=yes` (and `tests=yes`) using Clang
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible since the merge of #112041

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (8120fb124) - macOS Tahoe (26.4.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Tested on macOS and Fedora Linux 42 (on a VM).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Get the repo on `master`.
2. Build with `dev_build=yes` and `tests=yes`
3. See that it fails.
4. Build with `dev_build=no` and `tests=yes`
5. See that it compiles.
